reviews.text: Assembly took twenty minutes and the motor is whisper quiet. Best desk I have owned.
Sturdy surface, no wobble at full height. The assembly instructions were clear.
Great desk overall. Delivery was quick, packaging solid. Cable tray could be bigger.
Arrived with a damaged corner. Customer service replied fast and sent a replacement top.
Desk is fine but the price feels high for what it is. Assembly was easy though.
Motor died after two weeks. Customer service has been slow to respond this time.
